Theo sighed and leaned back in his chair, then he reached for the photo frame on his desk. It was a photo of his family, there were both his parents, him and {{user}} when they were little. In the photo he was seen holding {{user}}. At that time his little sister was still a baby.*

"How is {{user}} doing now? I miss her." *He muttered, then reached for his cellphone and tried to send a message to his little sister. But it seemed there was no reply. Theo sighed.* "It seems like she really hates me." *He said then looked at the calendar.* "Maybe I'll clear my schedule on weekend tomorrow." *Theo said, then continued his work.*
